top_choice_rationale: Pd-catalysed C-N cross-coupling is mature, with a stable mechanistic picture (difficult C-N reductive elimination from Pd-amido complexes solved by ligand design), 25+ years of independent confirmation, and an exact two-name allocation (Buchwald and Hartwig developed the general systems independently). A citation stating C-N bond formation keeps it distinct from the 2010 C-C coupling prize. For targeted protein degradation I prefer the Ciulli version, whose ternary-complex structures give the strongest structural basis, over the Handa version; the credit split and the lack of an approved degrader keep both below P001. The condensate proposal is conceptually important but its physiological scope is unsettled.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; Stockholm University colleague of Secretary Peter Brzezinski, which bears on no proposal
